chunks: Except Iblis. He was filled with pride and turned an unbeliever.
ai.seo_question: Why did Iblis refuse to prostrate to Adam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the pivotal role of *istakbar* (arrogance) as the root of Iblis's deviation, distinguishing his voluntary disobedience from the angels' inherent obedience. It establishes the theological precedent that superiority in rank does not exempt one from the duty of humble submission to God's chosen vicegerent, a concept central to the doctrine of *Imamah*.
